executive_summary: Four gates returned confidently wrong verdicts on correct work in one night, each by a different mechanism (wrong field read, wrong phase, wrong artifact scanned, wrong entry point bypassing a wrapper). All four named instances were independently re-verified to be ALREADY fixed before this SD was picked up (QF-20260903-722/020/822, QF-20260903-239 -> SD-LEO-FIX-GATE-PLAN-EXEC-001, all completed/closed -- confirmed from git history alone, zero open TODO markers remain). This SD's actual delivered scope -- deliberately NOT a fifth instance repair -- is the mirror of the already-ratified input-side gate-evidence-provenance rule (chairman-ratified 2026-09-02, 6c263823: no gate may accept evidence without producer/run/hash) applied to the OUTPUT side: a gate verdict should name what it measured, so a reader can tell a measurement of the work from a measurement of something adjacent to it without reading the write site. Delivered as Quick-Fix QF-20260903-379, merged via PR #8682 (commit 01ac0ae796b) BEFORE this SD existed -- escalated only because the diff touched a sensitive gate-criteria path that complete-quick-fix.js's eligibility preflight refuses to self-close without a full SD, by design, with no bypass flag. This SD is a retroactive verification record, re-derived fresh from the repo at HEAD rather than accepted from the commit message.

functional_requirements.title: An optional, additive measured-provenance contract on every gate verdict
functional_requirements.description: ValidatorRegistry.normalizeResult() (scripts/modules/handoff/validation/validator-registry/core.js) passes through an OPTIONAL `measured: { subject, producer }` field when a validator supplies one, via a conditional spread that adds zero keys when absent. Every gate that does not set it is completely unchanged -- confirmed: 7 total normalizeResult call sites across the gates directory, only 1 supplies measured, the other 6 are byte-identical to before this change. This is a fail-open contract, not a retrofit of every existing gate.
acceptance_criteria: normalizeResult({...}) with no `measured` key returns an object with no `measured` property at all (not `measured: undefined`).
normalizeResult({..., measured: {subject, producer}}) returns the `measured` object unchanged.
normalizeResult({..., measured: null}) does not leak an empty/null `measured` key into the output.

functional_requirements.title: One exemplar gate wired, not a retrofit of all four historically-buggy gates
functional_requirements.description: prdQualityValidation (gate-1-plan-to-exec.js) -- the same gate family QF-20260903-722 fixed after a prior version substring-matched a serialised requirement object instead of prose -- now builds `measured: { subject: 'PRD functional_requirements/acceptance_criteria/executive_summary (heuristic|AI-rubric scoring)', producer: 'validatePRDQuality (...)' }` and passes it into normalizeResult. The other three historically-buggy gates deliberately do NOT yet emit `measured` -- retrofitting every gate individually would repeat the exact 'fix instances, not the class' mistake this SD's own premise names.
acceptance_criteria: Calling the registered prdQualityValidation validator returns a result whose `measured.subject` matches /PRD/ and `measured.producer` matches /validatePRDQuality/.
This holds for both the heuristic and AI-rubric scoring paths.

functional_requirements.title: The measured line is visible to an operator at the actual read site, not only the write site
functional_requirements.description: HandoffOrchestrator.js's PLAN-TO-EXEC precheck "GATE SCORES (Precheck)" display loop imports formatMeasuredLine (lib/governance/verdict-measured-provenance.js, a small pure/testable helper) and prints the measured line for a gate result when present, immediately after that gate's existing pass/fail/percentage line. A gate result with no `measured` field prints nothing extra -- unchanged display for every other gate.
acceptance_criteria: formatMeasuredLine(gateResult) returns null when gateResult has no measured field, or when subject/producer is missing.
formatMeasuredLine(gateResult) returns a string naming both the subject and the producer when both are present.
HandoffOrchestrator.js's precheck loop calls formatMeasuredLine per gate result and only logs the line when it is non-null.

risks.risk: A reviewer could read this SD as re-fixing the four cited gates, when it deliberately does not
risks.mitigation: Explicitly documented in the PRD, the commit message, and the PR description: all 4 named instances were already fixed individually before this SD existed; this SD's only new surface is the provenance CONTRACT plus ONE exemplar.

risks.risk: The additive `measured` field could be mistaken for a required field, causing a future caller to assume every gate result has one
risks.mitigation: hasMeasuredProvenance/formatMeasuredLine are both null-safe by construction (optional chaining, explicit Boolean()), and the contract's own module header states plainly that omitting it is unchanged, fail-open behavior.

Any future gate author who opts in to the measured contract when registering a new validator
